---
title: "Glossary"
subtitle: "Every technical word used in this course, in plain language"
number-sections: false
---

Terms are listed alphabetically. The right-hand column says where the term is
explained in context.

| Term | Meaning | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| **Alt text** | A written description of an image, read aloud by screen readers and shown when the image cannot load | [4](04-media-tables-references.qmd) |
| **Callout** | A coloured box for a note, tip, warning or similar remark | [3](03-write-text.qmd) |
| **Commit** | A saved, labelled snapshot of your changes in a repository | [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **Docs folder** (`docs`) | The folder where the finished website is written. It is what gets published | [1](01-set-up.qmd), [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **GitHub / GitLab** | Websites that store projects online and can also show their web pages to the public | [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **Markdown** | A way of formatting text with a few plain symbols, such as `##` for a heading and `**` for bold | [3](03-write-text.qmd) |
| **Mermaid** | A tool that draws a diagram from a short text description | [4](04-media-tables-references.qmd) |
| **Pages** | The GitHub and GitLab feature that shows the files of a repository as a website | [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **Push** | Sending your commits from your computer to the online repository | [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **`.qmd` file** | A text file holding one chapter. The extension stands for "Quarto markdown" | [1](01-set-up.qmd) |
| **Quarto** | The program that turns the text files into a website. It is included in RStudio | [1](01-set-up.qmd) |
| **R** | The engine that RStudio runs on. You do not need to write R code for this template | [1](01-set-up.qmd) |
| **Render** | To build the website from the text files. In RStudio: the **Render Website** button | [1](01-set-up.qmd) |
| **Repository** | A project folder stored online together with the history of its changes | [8](08-publish.qmd) |
| **RStudio** | The program in which you write the course and press Render | [1](01-set-up.qmd) |
| **Sidebar** | The chapter list on the left of every page; set in `_quarto.yml` | [2](02-plan-and-structure.qmd) |
| **Source / Visual mode** | The two views of the RStudio editor: plain text with symbols, or a word-processor look | [1](01-set-up.qmd), [3](03-write-text.qmd) |
| **Speaker notes** | Notes on a slide that only the presenter sees | [6](06-slides.qmd) |
| **Task list** | A bullet list with checkboxes; here it is how quiz options are written | [5](05-quizzes.qmd) |
| **WCAG** | The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, the standard for accessible websites | [7](07-check-before-release.qmd) |
| **YAML** (`.yml`) | A strict, indentation-based settings format. `_quarto.yml` is written in it | [2](02-plan-and-structure.qmd) |
